patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and Zoho CRM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and Zoho CRM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Salesforce only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and ” rather than Zoho CRM's shape. Choose Zoho CRM only if your buying job matches “Affordable multi-edition sales CRM with free tier, automation, and Zia AI across Standard ” rather than Salesforce's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Salesforce is shaped for Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer da whereas Zoho CRM is shaped for Affordable multi-edition sales CRM with free tier, automation, and Zia. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce and Zoho CRM share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Salesforce is Enterprise CRM platform for sales, service, marketing, and customer data across large and mid-market teams.; Zoho CRM is Affordable multi-edition sales CRM with free tier, automation, and Zia AI across Standard through Ultimate..
- Company-size focus: Salesforce (mid-market, enterprise) vs Zoho CRM (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Salesforce — USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Zoho CRM — Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate..

Limitations — Salesforce: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO.; Premier Support is an add-on on Pro Suite. Agentforce for Sales, Sales Programs, Revenue Intelligence, and Revenue Cloud are separate paid add-ons; some require Contact us.; Zoho CRM: Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate.; Free edition limited to 3 users..

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce is a poor fit when that limitation bites: USD list pricing rises quickly: Pro Suite $100, Enterprise $175, Unlimited $350 per user/month (annual). Add-ons (Agentforce for Sales from $125 Contact us, Revenue Intelligence, Success Plans) increase TCO. · Zoho CRM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Zia AI and advanced automation depth concentrate on Enterprise/Ultimate. · Avoid Salesforce if you actually need Zoho CRM's motion (Affordable multi-edition sales CRM with free tier, automation, and Zia AI across)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
